# Vendored Boat client

`vendor/sandbox-client` contains the clean source of
[nessalabs/boat-client-rs](https://github.com/nessalabs/boat-client-rs) at
`4d68256bb0b6a889633abc567fb09214681874db`, under its included MIT license.
It is vendored so SDK consumers do not need a sibling checkout.

There are no local source patches. The earlier file-write correction and live
reports remain dated historical evidence in `docs/evidence/README.md` and
`docs/evidence/boat-client-file-write.patch`. Current client validation is
recorded separately; those historical probes do not certify later revisions.
